version.description: The file's format version. Aphelion migrates older ones.

address.description: The address the server listens on. In the container that's 0.0.0.0, the container's own interface. The Compose file decides which host address the port is published on.

port.description: The TCP port the server listens on. Normally 7400.

title: server.yaml
description: Where the server listens for HTTP and WebSocket connections (decisions 0016 and 0022).
